integrity: A fully symbolic infinite-domain proof is supplied. Independent finite integer verification is supplementary, not infinite certification. Originality conclusions are limited to the examined literature; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Covers exactly the one-step map n ↦ φ(n)+3 on all positive integers; classifies all eventual cycles and the least universal eventual upper bound, not attraction-basin densities, entrance times or other shifts. The 23↔25 cycle is previously known as an example; the globally exhaustive classification and sharp universal bound are the asserted contribution.
title: Exact global dynamics of the shift-three Euler totient map
